items.name: Executive slide catalog
items.summary: Strategy, performance, decision, risk, business case and transformation layouts.
items.when: When to use: you know the message but not the layout.
items.example: A margin bridge that walks from last quarter's margin to this quarter's, one bar per driver.

items.name: Storytelling playbook
items.summary: How to structure a narrative leaders follow: situation, complication, resolution, ask.
items.when: When to use: before you draft any slide.
items.example: Revenue beat plan (situation), but margin slipped (complication); a price change fixes it (resolution); approve it (ask).

items.name: Visual library
items.summary: Approved charts, diagrams, icons, roadmaps, matrices and process flows.
items.when: When to use: you need a visual that matches the brand.
items.example: The three-wave roadmap with decision gates marked as diamonds.

items.name: Writing guide
items.summary: Action headlines, concise wording and recommendations that start with a verb.
items.when: When to use: tightening headlines and bullets.
items.example: Replace “Q3 revenue overview” with “Q3 revenue beat plan by 4% on enterprise growth”.

items.name: Data visualization guide
items.summary: Rules for choosing the right chart and presenting metrics honestly.
items.when: When to use: choosing between a bar, line, waterfall or table.
items.example: Use a waterfall to explain the change between two totals; never a pie with more than three parts.

items.name: Corporate standards
items.summary: Fonts, colours, master layouts, terminology and confidentiality labels.
items.when: When to use: checking a deck before it leaves your team.
items.example: Every slide footer carries the label chosen in the governance bar.

items.name: Example presentations
items.summary: Approved decks and single slides that passed executive review.
items.when: When to use: you want to see what good looks like.
items.example: The FY26 board pack: nine slides with a one-page pre-read.

items.name: Quality checklist
items.summary: Executive readiness, factual accuracy, consistency and design checks.
items.when: When to use: the final pass before sending.
items.example: Answer first, action titles, one message per slide, a source on every chart.
